title: ONION-Q procurement grading policy
description: A policy converts measurements into procurement decisions. Policies are versioned and hashed; decisions record the exact policy id + hash used. Official values must only be entered after verification (source_verified=true) - see POLICY_SOURCES.md.

source_verified.description: true only when taken from an official specification document held by the team; when true, source_url + verification_date + an official source_type are REQUIRED and enforced by src/grading/policy.py

source_type.description: kind of evidence behind the thresholds; news_context can never be verified

source_url.description: URL or file reference of the specification actually used

verification_date.description: ISO date the specification was checked by a human

effective_to.description: ISO date the policy stops applying

grades.description: Ordered decision classes with their acceptance rules

require_calibration_for_decision.description: when true, uncalibrated size forces manual review instead of a size-based decision
